test_title: PYST 12: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice which cannot be formed on folding the given sheet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be39a94ff3c1ecd97dc2cec2b0477e1820a791af8474fa428387eef94c6b9ada.png]
solution:
From the given open Dice:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc1f1def1dba725f25d20d635a8fd8940c916d69c0026c4024a297a0e5f68636.png] 

'x' and 'c' are the opposite sides.

'a' and 'f' are the opposite sides.

'd' and 'g' are the opposite sides.

 And, two opposite sides can not be adjacent surfaces, so it can't be shown in a dice.

Now,

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0794641f52dbe89720ecfbfc591a394d3559659b70209274229028d86b62ed5.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are of adjacent sides.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92fe4797424cdb695df8e225196aeb8cda606575292f96833e4e2634a95047f0.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are of adjacent sides.

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02155c8d670ad99b7a52ff209bb74c3638a81d9bd27395ba181654ba5d8aef3f.png] →** Can not be made, because 'a' and 'f' are the opposite sides.**

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56ea9d9c3faca741248236a3de1ed9db000378c2b4f896e4621f4361d0425c45.png] → Can be made, because all the surfaces are of adjacent sides.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".
